description: Change masks on layers (Layer > Mask): mode, inversion, lock (or lock every other mask: Lock Other Masks; unlock them all: Unlock All Masks), outline colour, RotoBezier, Motion Blur (same as layer, on, off), Feather Falloff (smooth, linear), feather, opacity, expansion, name and selection

color.description: Mask outline colour in the viewers and Timeline, "#RRGGBB" or "rgb(r,g,b)"

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

featherFalloff.description: Feather falloff curve (Layer > Mask > Feather Falloff)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

lockOthers.description: Lock every other mask on the layer (Lock Other Masks)

locked.description: Lock or unlock the masks (false with masks omitted: Unlock All Masks)

masks.description: Which masks on each layer: indexes (1-based, as in the Timeline) or names. Omit for every mask

motionBlur.description: Mask motion blur (Layer > Mask > Motion Blur)

name.description: Rename the mask (one mask per layer only)

rotoBezier.description: RotoBezier: curves calculated through the vertices

name: set_masks
title: Set Masks
